thread.title: Wells Fargo Reiterates Hold Rating for Apple (AAPL)

author: Max Byerly
title: Wells Fargo Reiterates Hold Rating for Apple (AAPL)
text:
Tweet
Wells Fargo restated their hold rating on shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a research report released on Tuesday. The firm currently has a $195.00 price target on the iPhone maker’s stock.
“07:1704/19/1804/1907:1704/19/1807:17Apple (AAPL) could outline plans of incremental $100B share repo, says Wells Fargo”,” Wells Fargo’s analyst commented. Get Apple alerts:
Several other research analysts have also issued reports on AAPL. UBS set a $190.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a buy rating in a research note on Tuesday. Vetr lowered shares of Apple from a strong-buy rating to a buy rating and set a $186.86 target price on the stock. in a research note on Monday, April 2nd. Nomura set a $175.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a neutral rating in a research note on Tuesday, April 3rd. BMO Capital Markets lowered shares of Apple from an outperform rating to a market perform rating and increased their target price for the stock from $162.00 to $166.00 in a research note on Wednesday, January 31st. Finally, Morningstar set a $170.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a neutral rating in a research note on Friday, February 2nd. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the company. Apple has a consensus rating of Buy and an average price target of $203.15. AAPL opened at $164.22 on Tuesday. Apple has a twelve month low of $142.20 and a twelve month high of $183.50. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. The firm has a market cap of $830,362.25, a PE ratio of 17.83, a PEG ratio of 1.25 and a beta of 1.25.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period in the prior year, the company posted $3.36 earnings per share. research analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.3 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.

The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this hyperlink . Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 64,475 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold 125,988 shares of company stock valued at $21,336,201 in the last 90 days. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
